blocks.content: Quiz: A component uses queryKey: ['tasks'] but fetches tasks filtered by status. The user changes the filter. What happens?
Tap an option below to answer:
React Query refetches automatically because the filter changed
React Query only knows to refetch when the key changes. The key is still ['tasks'] here.
React Query only knows to refetch when the key changes. The key is still ['tasks'] here.
React Query returns the old cached data because the key didn't change
The key never changed so React Query serves whatever is sitting in the cache.
The key never changed so React Query serves whatever is sitting in the cache.
React Query throws an error about a mismatched key
No error is thrown. The wrong data just shows up silently, which is the real danger.
No error is thrown. The wrong data just shows up silently, which is the real danger.
The component re-renders but isLoading stays false
The component may re-render but it will show the wrong data, not trigger a new fetch.
The component may re-render but it will show the wrong data, not trigger a new fetch.
